maria: Heads-up 1 we need to finalize the NimbusOne customer story. Items: interview, hero + long quote, legal OK on perf numbers, gated benchmark PDF, and a short webinar. Target publish Thu next week. Can we land by Tue EOD?

quentin: I can run the interview Mon 10am PT. Will focus on infra changes and rollout risk.

asha: I'll draft two quote options. Short hero should be <15 words.

devin: Bench snapshot: median ~55% lower, p99 ~2.8x improvement after routing + cache. I'll export a redacted CSV and a sanitized command for the appendix.

sara: Sales asks post-publish routing to enterprise-inbound@ and AE-queue. Also tag source=nimbus.

legal-bot: Reminder: no contract figures or raw user counts. Replace absolute metrics language with "large-scale production traffic" unless Nimbus confirms. Upload NDA/consent to drive link.

maria: Promo plan: announcement + webinar invite + 2 reminders. Promo needs hero quote and speaker name. @asha please prioritize.

asha: Drafts: 
- hero: "Redwood made our inference reliably fast for production."
- long: "Switching to Redwood's routing and prefix caching dropped median latency ~55% and improved p99 ~2.8x, letting us launch lower-latency features while reducing unit cost."

quentin: I'll get live approval for the hero line during the call. Also capture a 1-line speaker bio.

devin: Sanitary perf command skeleton: 
```
./run_bench --model open-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --samples 1000 > out.json
```
Legal: confirm ok to publish after stripping internal flags.

legal-bot: That skeleton is fine once internal flags/datasets are removed. I will review the transcript + CSV after upload; expect ~48h turnaround.

promo-bot: Staging webinar page created: /campaigns/nimbusone/webinar-staging. Will publish after hero quote added.

maria: Checklist recap: interview scheduled, NDA/consent uploaded, quotes captured, legal review, gated PDF, post-publish routing test, webinar page live. Checkpoint Tue EOD.

end of thread
